text_markup: A paid ability that refers to ice the Runner is encountering can only be used during an encounter with a piece of ice that meets all stipulations used in referring to it.
text_plain: A paid ability that refers to ice the Runner is encountering can only be used during an encounter with a piece of ice that meets all stipulations used in referring to it.

examples.text_markup: The Runner cannot trigger the first ability on {card:Arruaceiras Crew} at an arbitrary time to give themself a tag. They can only use this ability during an encounter.
examples.text_plain: The Runner cannot trigger the first ability on Arruaceiras Crew at an arbitrary time to give themself a tag. They can only use this ability during an encounter.

examples.text_markup: The Runner can use the [trash] ability on {card:Abagnale} during an encounter with a {subtype:code gate}. They can only use the interface ability on {card:Abagnale} during an encounter with a {subtype:code gate} that {card:Abagnale} has sufficient strength to interface with.
examples.text_plain: The Runner can use the {trash} ability on Abagnale during an encounter with a code gate. They can only use the interface ability on Abagnale during an encounter with a code gate that Abagnale has sufficient strength to interface with.
